A callback that resolves a child through the active resolver chain (including caching, normalization, and ordering). Returns the resolved , or if no resolver in the chain claims the child section. Always non-null; resolvers that do not need the chain can ignore the callback. Must only be invoked synchronously during this call; capturing the callback and invoking it after TryResolve returns will throw .
When this method returns , contains the constructed provider; otherwise .
Docs.summary: Attempts to construct an for the supplied credential configuration section, with access to a callback that recursively resolves child sections through the same active resolver chain.
Docs.returns: if this resolver recognized and handled the section; to defer to the next resolver in the chain.
Docs.remarks: This overload exists so chain-owning resolvers (e.g., a resolver that builds a ChainedTokenCredential from child Sources[] entries) can recurse back into the active engine for each child entry without re-implementing the engine's caching, normalization, or ordering logic — and without requiring the resolver to know about credential sources owned by other packages. Subclasses override to participate; this method wraps with a guard that enforces the synchronous-use contract and then forwards to TryResolveCore.
